question: What identity and power define the great knowledge named Kāmākhyā?
premises: Kāmākhyā is the great knowledge in womb-form
Kāmākhyā is the giver of boons
inference: Kāmākhyā is identified as the womb-formed supreme knowledge who grants boons
plain_english: Kāmākhyā is the great knowledge in the form of the womb, the giver of boons.
